title: 第529章 宿友的选择第528章 告知超凡真相
slug: 全球没功法的我自创功法
content_zh:
林道掌心微握，那团躁动的火焰瞬间湮灭，只余下空气中淡淡的焦灼味。
他环视四人，神色肃然：“关于超凡世界，你们想知道什么？我知无不言。”
王云浩眼珠子一转，搓着手凑到欧阳小白面前，一脸谄媚：“小白，既然大家都是同道中人，要不你也露两手。
让我们开开眼。”
欧阳小白正拿着纸巾，细致温柔地为小悠朵擦拭嘴角的饼干碎屑，闻言连头都没抬，声音清冷如冰泉：“抱歉，我不喜欢像马戏团一样卖弄能力。”
“去去去，没眼力见。”
张三抬脚在王云浩屁股上，不轻不重地踹了一下，随即正色看向林道，“老林，别理这胖子。
你跟我们详细科普一下，这超凡世界到底是个什么规矩。”
林道沉吟片刻，开始将超凡界的等级划分、力量体系以及大夏官方的管控机制，抽丝剥茧般讲给这群挚友听。
欧阳小白偶尔，在一旁补充几句关于古武世家的秘辛，将王云浩、张三等人原本构建的唯物主义世界观，彻底粉碎后重组。
当得知这世上有一群人，能轻易撕碎凡人，且晨曦学府内，就隐藏着不少这样的存在时。
四人脸上的兴奋逐渐褪去，取而代之的是一种深入骨髓的焦虑与惶恐，甚至还有一丝身为凡人的不甘。
张三推了推眼镜，镜片后折射出冷冽的光：“林道，超凡者就能随意对普通人出手吗？当
力量失去约束，罪恶就会滋生。
我敢断言，若无监管，超凡者就是社会最大的不稳定因素。”
“不能。”
林道摇头否决，语气斩钉截铁，“大夏境内，有官方超凡组织维持秩序。
一旦出现超凡者滥杀无辜，杀人者即便逃到天涯海角，也会被追杀至死。”
他深深看了张三一眼：“你在金陵府城见到的那群黑衣人，正是大夏官方超凡组织的成员。”
张三闻言，若有所思地点点头，紧绷的肩膀稍稍放松。

吴磊面色复杂，忍不住问道：“那大夏究竟有多少超凡者？”
“不多。”
林道伸出一根手指，“大夏近三十亿人口，登记在册的超凡者，不到二十万。”
王云浩四人一听，心凉了半截。
这概率，简直比中彩票还低。
他们这种普通人，想跨入那个世界，岂不是难如登天？
尚杰与王云浩终于忍不住，异口同声问道：“老林，那我们……有机会成为超凡者吗？”
林道目光深邃，视线在四人脸上缓缓扫过，神情变得异常凝重：“你们生在了最好的时代，却也撞上了最坏的时代。”
“何意？”
“最好的时代，是因为灵气复苏，大夏所有人都有了踏上超凡之路的资格。”
“最坏的时代，是因为一旦踏入这条路，你们就必须承受这股力量，背后的时代洪流。
在这股洪流之下，无数生命会如草芥般殒命。”
content_en:
Lin Dao clenched his palm slightly, and the restless flame was instantly extinguished, leaving only a faint burning smell in the air.
He looked around the four people with a solemn expression: "What do you want to know about the extraordinary world? I know everything."
Wang Yunhao rolled his eyes, rubbed his hands and approached Ouyang Xiaobai, with a flattering look on his face: "Xiaobai, since we are all in the same camp, why don't you show off your skills too.
Let's open our eyes. "
Ouyang Xiaobai was holding a tissue and carefully and tenderly wiping the cookie crumbs from the corners of Xiao Youduo's mouth. He didn't even raise his head when he heard this, and his voice was as cold as ice spring: "Sorry, I don't like to show off my abilities like a circus."
"Go, go, go, I can't see it."
Zhang San raised his foot and kicked Wang Yunhao's butt gently, then looked at Lin seriously and said, "Old Lin, ignore this fat man.
Please tell us in detail what the rules of this extraordinary world are. "
Lin Dao pondered for a moment, and then began to explain to these close friends the hierarchy of the extraordinary world, the power system, and the official control mechanism of Daxia.
Ouyang Xiaobai occasionally added a few secrets about the ancient martial arts family, completely smashing and reorganizing the materialistic worldview originally constructed by Wang Yunhao, Zhang San and others.
When I learned that there is a group of people in this world who can easily tear mortals apart, and there are many such beings hidden in Chenxi Academy.
The excitement on the faces of the four people gradually faded away, replaced by a deep-rooted anxiety and fear, and even a trace of mortal unwillingness.
Zhang San pushed up his glasses, and a cold light was reflected behind the lenses: "Lin Dao, can extraordinary people attack ordinary people at will? When
When power is unchecked, evil will flourish.
I dare to assert that without supervision, extraordinary people are the biggest destabilizing factor in society. "
"Can't."
Lin Dao shook his head and objected, with a firm tone, "In Daxia, there is an official extraordinary organization to maintain order.
Once an extraordinary person appears and kills innocent people indiscriminately, the murderer will be hunted to death even if he escapes to the ends of the earth. "
He took a deep look at Zhang San: "The group of men in black you saw in Jinling Fucheng are members of Daxia's official extraordinary organization."
Hearing this, Zhang San nodded thoughtfully and relaxed his tense shoulders slightly.
Wu Lei looked complicated and couldn't help but ask: "How many extraordinary people are there in Daxia?"
"Not much."
Lin Dao stretched out a finger and said, "Daxia has a population of nearly three billion, and there are less than two hundred thousand registered extraordinary beings."
When Wang Yunhao and the other four heard this, their hearts froze.
This probability is simply lower than winning the lottery.
For ordinary people like them, if they want to step into that world, wouldn't it be as difficult as climbing to the sky?
Shang Jie and Wang Yunhao finally couldn't help it and asked in unison: "Old Lin, do we... have a chance to become extraordinary?"
Lin Dao's eyes were deep, and his eyes slowly swept over the faces of the four people, and his expression became extremely solemn: "You were born in the best of times, but you also ran into the worst of times."
"What do you mean?"
"The best era is when spiritual energy is revived and everyone in Great Xia is qualified to embark on the path to transcendence."
“The worst era is because once you step on this path, you must bear the power and the torrent of the times behind you.
Under this torrent, countless lives will perish like nothing. "
